name: gh-gemini-review-loop
description: Run the AI reviewer PR loop with Codex or Gemini Code Assist: wait, fetch actionable threads, fix, push, re-request review. Capped by preference, severity-aware, auditable.

interface.shortDescription: Turn AI reviewer PR comments into a capped fix loop.
interface.longDescription: Run an opinionated AI code-review PR loop from Codex: pick the reviewer for the PR (Codex or Gemini Code Assist), wait for its review, read real GitHub review-thread state, fix actionable comments in priority order, verify with repo-aware checks, push, request re-review, and stop at a configurable cap.
